title: 脚付き密閉膨張タンク
description: 建物の温水・空調機械室に配置する密閉膨張タンク外装。赤い丸胴と中央の継ぎ目、三本の広がった脚と足板、上部保護キャップ、底部接続外形、側面の実開口ノズル、無記載の銘板を造形。屋上の開放型貯水槽とは異なる機械室用の単体プロップです。内部隔膜・流体・圧力調整は省略し、耐圧や設備安全性を示す製造設計ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.770 × 1.365 × 0.727 m、8,520三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A closed expansion-vessel exterior for building hot-water and HVAC plant rooms. It has a red rounded shell and central seam, three splayed legs/feet, top protective cap, lower connection exterior, genuinely open side nozzle and blank identification plate. This plant-room prop is distinct from an elevated open water-storage installation. Internal diaphragm, fluid and pressure regulation are omitted; it is not a manufacturing design or evidence of pressure or equipment safety. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.770 × 1.365 × 0.727 m; 8,520 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
